title: M6 binary leading-XOR Euclid and actual cubic preprocessing cost
scope: Actual fuel-based binary leading-term remainder and Euclidean recursion; exact normalized gcd, telescoping cancellation/round bounds, faithful fixed-width dense XOR updates and conservative original indexed-array bit cost including degree preparation.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.binary_normalization
spec.statement: ∀ p : M6.Euclid.BP, (p ≠ 0 → p.Monic) ∧ normalize p = p
spec.guidance: Every binary leading coefficient is0 or1, by ordinary decide over ZMod2. Nonzero p has nonzero leadingCoeff, hence1. Use Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self; handle zero separately. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.rank_order
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, (M6.Euclid.rank p < M6.Euclid.rank q ↔ p.degree < q.degree) ∧ (M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ M6.Euclid.rank q ↔ p.degree ≤ q.degree)
spec.guidance: Split p=0 and q=0; unfold rank and use Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree for nonzero polynomials. The zero polynomial has rank0 and degree bottom. Preserve constants. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.cancel_drop
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → q.degree ≤ p.degree → M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.cancel p q) < M6.Euclid.rank p
spec.guidance: Apply Polynomial.div_wf_lemma to the actual cancellation definition and binary_normalization for monicity of q; transport degree strictness through rank_order. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.cancel_mod
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, M6.Euclid.cancel p q % q = p % q
spec.guidance: Use Polynomial.mod_eq_of_dvd_sub: cancel p q - p is a multiple ofq, directly by ring. Or ordinary Euclidean remainder add/sub/mul congruence. No nonzero assumptions required. spec.name: M6.Euclid.remainder_aux_correct
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ fuel → (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel p q).value = p % q ∧ (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel p q).cancellations + M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel p q).value ≤ M6.Euclid.rank p
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing p. At fuel0 rankp=0 forcesp=0. At stopping guard use mod_zero, zero_mod or Polynomial.mod_eq_self_iff q_nonzero. Otherwise cancel_drop gives enough remaining fuel; apply induction to cancel, cancel_mod and integer/natural arithmetic. The cancellation potential includes final remainder rank. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.remainder_correct
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, (M6.Euclid.remainder p q).value = p % q ∧ (M6.Euclid.remainder p q).cancellations + M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.remainder p q).value ≤ M6.Euclid.rank p ∧ (q ≠ 0 → M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.remainder p q).value < M6.Euclid.rank q)
spec.guidance: Instantiate remainder_aux_correct at rankp; the extra degree-preparation pass does not change value/cancellations. For the final strict remainder bound use Polynomial.degree_mod_lt and rank_order. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.euclid_aux_correct
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank q < fuel → (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).value = EuclideanDomain.gcd q p ∧ (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).cancellations + M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).value ≤ M6.Euclid.rank p + M6.Euclid.rank q ∧ (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).rounds ≤ M6.Euclid.rank q
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing p q. Base impossible. q0 stops with EuclideanDomain.gcd_zero_left. Otherwise remainder_correct gives rankr<rankq, sufficient recursive fuel, and c_rem+rankr≤rankp. EuclideanDomain.gcd_val q p rewrites gcd q p to gcd (p%q) q, matching recursion. Add induction potential inequality and remainder inequality; cancellation counts telescope even if degp<degq initially. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.normalized_gcd
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, EuclideanDomain.gcd q p = GCDMonoid.gcd p q
spec.guidance: Use dvd_antisymm_of_normalize_eq: all binary polynomials normalize to themselves, and normalize_gcd holds for the normalized GCDMonoid gcd. EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left/right/dvd_gcd and root gcd_dvd_left/right/dvd_gcd show mutual divisibility. Keep the EuclideanDomain versus GCDMonoid namespaces explicit. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.euclid_correct
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).value = GCDMonoid.gcd p q ∧ (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).cancellations ≤ M6.Euclid.rank p + M6.Euclid.rank q ∧ (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).rounds ≤ M6.Euclid.rank q
spec.guidance: Use euclid_aux_correct with fuel rankq+1 and normalized_gcd. The top-level initial degree scan only changes passes. Drop the nonnegative final-rank term from the cancellation bound. spec.name: M6.Euclid.remainder_passes
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel p q).passes = 2 * (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel p q).cancellations + 1
spec.guidance: Direct structural induction fuel generalizing p q. Stopping states charge one scan; each executed cancellation adds two passes. This is an actual recursive counter identity, not a declared polynomial bound. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.euclid_aux_passes
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).passes = 2 * (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).cancellations + 3 * (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).rounds + 1
spec.guidance: Induct fuel. Unfold remainder and apply remainder_passes: each remainder call costs2c+2, including its initial degree/fuel scan; each Euclid call charges its own zero/degree scan. spec.name: M6.Euclid.scan_cost
spec.statement: ∀ width : ℕ, M6.Euclid.scanCost width = width * (6 * width + 4) ∧ (0 < width → M6.Euclid.scanCost width ≤ 10 * width ^ 2)
spec.guidance: Prove a generalized foldl accumulator formula for the explicit List.range loop, or use List.foldl_assoc with addition. Every loop iteration adds6width+4. The quadratic bound follows for positive width by arithmetic; cost is derived from the loop, not defined as width squared. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.dense_cancel
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), p ≠ 0 → M6.Euclid.dense N (M6.Euclid.cancel p q) = M6.Euclid.denseXor N p q (p.natDegree - q.natDegree)
spec.guidance: Nonzero binary p has leadingCoeff1. Expand cancel and dense/List.ofFn; coefficient of q*X^shift is q.coeff(i-shift) when shift≤i, else0. Binary subtraction is addition/XOR (CharTwo). Prove list equality via ofFn congruence or ext entries. This connects the actual polynomial update to the dense indexed-array update. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.dense_rank
spec.statement: ∀ (width : ℕ) (p : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ width → M6.Euclid.scanRank width p = M6.Euclid.rank p
spec.guidance: Induct width using List.range_succ and List.foldl_append. Under rankp≤width+1, either rankp≤width and coefficient atwidth iszero, so induction persists; or rankp=width+1, so nonzero p has natDegreewidth and leading coefficient nonzero, and the final iteration setswidth+1. Basewidth0 forcesp0. This proves actual coefficient-array degree scanning, leaving no degree oracle. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.dense_injective
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ N + 1 → M6.Euclid.rank q ≤ N + 1 → M6.Euclid.dense N p = M6.Euclid.dense N q → p = q
spec.guidance: Polynomial.ext on coefficient indexi. Ifi<N+1, extract the matching List.ofFn entry. Otherwise both coefficients vanish by degree bounds, splitting zero polynomial when converting rank to natDegree. Thus truncated arrays are faithful when the invariant holds. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.remainder_safe
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP) (width : ℕ), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ width → M6.Euclid.rank q ≤ width → M6.Euclid.remainderSafe fuel p q width
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing p. The stopping predicate needs no recursion. Otherwise cancel_drop bounds the next operand strictly below p, preserving both fixed-width bounds. This ghost safety predicate checks every actual recursive intermediate operand. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.euclid_safe
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP) (width : ℕ), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ width → M6.Euclid.rank q ≤ width → M6.Euclid.euclidSafe fuel p q width
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing p q. For nonzeroq, remainder_safe proves its entire inner loop fits width; remainder_correct bounds rank of its value by rankp (or strictly by rankq), then apply induction to the next Euclid pair. No fuel sufficiency premise needed for width safety. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.euclid_output_width
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).value ≤ max (M6.Euclid.rank p) (M6.Euclid.rank q)
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing p q. Stopping output is p. Otherwise remainder_correct bounds rankr≤rankp, and induction gives output≤max(rankq,rankr)≤max(rankp,rankq). This supplies the width bound when composing two gcd calls. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.bit_cost_bound
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), p.natDegree ≤ N → q.natDegree ≤ N → M6.Euclid.bitCost N p q ≤ 90 * (N + 1) ^ 3 ∧ M6.Euclid.euclidSafe (M6.Euclid.rank q + 1) p q (N + 1)
spec.guidance: Rankp,rankq≤N+1 by definition, including zero. euclid_correct gives c≤2width and e≤width; euclid_passes yields passes≤7width+2≤9width forwidth=N+1≥1. scan_cost≤10width², hence≤90width³ by multiplication arithmetic. euclid_safe proves every actual operand fits these arrays. No arbitrary oracle/cost premise. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.

spec.name: M6.Euclid.preprocess_correct_cost
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a b M : M6.Euclid.BP), a.natDegree ≤ N → b.natDegree ≤ N → M.natDegree ≤ N → (M6.Euclid.preprocess a b M).value = GCDMonoid.gcd (GCDMonoid.gcd a b) M ∧ M6.Euclid.preprocessBitCost N a b M ≤ 180 * (N + 1) ^ 3
spec.guidance: Unfold the actual shared two-call preprocessing. euclid_correct identifies first and final outputs. euclid_output_width bounds the first result rank bymax initial ranks≤N+1, hence natDegree≤N (split zero if needed). Apply bit_cost_bound to both calls and distribute pass count times scanCost. This is source gcd(a,b,M) preprocessing with its conservative cubic bit bound. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.
